verses.text_urhobo: Enana ye orua rẹ emọ ri Noa, Shẹm, Ham, kugbe Jafẹt, rẹ oghwe na vwọ kpọnu ayen de rhi vwiẹ emọ.
verses.text_romanized: enana ye orua re emo ri noa shem ham kugbe jafet re oghwe na vwo kponu ayen de rhi vwie emo

verses.text_urhobo: Emọ ri Jafẹt kẹ ena: Goma, Magog, Madai, Javan, Tubal, Mẹshẹk, Tiras.
verses.text_romanized: emo ri jafet ke ena goma magog madai javan tubal meshek tiras

verses.text_urhobo: Emọ ri Goma kẹ ena: Ashkenaz, Rifat, kugbe Togarma.
verses.text_romanized: emo ri goma ke ena ashkenaz rifat kugbe togarma

verses.text_urhobo: Emọ ri Javan Elishah, Tarshish, Kitim, kugbe Dodanim.
verses.text_romanized: emo ri javan elishah tarshish kitim kugbe dodanim

verses.text_urhobo: Oma rẹ ihwo nana kọye ihwo rẹ orhoma rẹ urhie na nurhe. Enana keye emọ ri Jafẹt vwẹ otọ rayen, dohwo depherẹ rọye, vẹ uvwiẹ rayen, vwẹ evun rẹ ẹgborho rayen.
verses.text_romanized: oma re ihwo nana koye ihwo re orhoma re urhie na nurhe enana keye emo ri jafet vwe oto rayen dohwo dephere roye ve uvwie rayen vwe evun re egborho rayen

verses.text_urhobo: Emọ ri Ham Kush, Ijipt, Put, kugbe Kenan
verses.text_romanized: emo ri ham kush ijipt put kugbe kenan

verses.text_urhobo: Emọ ri Kush Seba, Havilah, Sabta, Raama, kugbe Sabteka. Emọ ri Raama Sheba kugbe Dedan.
verses.text_romanized: emo ri kush seba havilah sabta raama kugbe sabteka emo ri raama sheba kugbe dedan

verses.text_urhobo: Kush kọye ọsẹ ri Nimrọd, ọye ohwo rẹ ẹsosuọ vwẹ akpọ na rọ to dia ọgban.
verses.text_romanized: kush koye ose ri nimrod oye ohwo re esosuo vwe akpo na ro to dia ogban

verses.text_urhobo: Ọ da dia ọgban rẹ ibefii rode vwẹ obaro rẹ Ọrovwohwo, fiki rẹ ọtiọye kọye a vwọ tanẹ, Kiri Nimrọd ọgban rẹ ibefi rode vwẹ obaro rẹ Ọrovwohwo.
verses.text_romanized: o da dia ogban re ibefii rode vwe obaro re orovwohwo fiki re otioye koye a vwo tane kiri nimrod ogban re ibefi rode vwe obaro re orovwohwo

verses.text_urhobo: Emuophihọ rẹ uvie rọye ki Babẹl, Erẹk kugbe Akad, enana ejobi kẹ otọ ri Shinar epha.
verses.text_romanized: emuophiho re uvie roye ki babel erek kugbe akad enana ejobi ke oto ri shinar epha

verses.text_urhobo: Otọ yena kọye o nu kpo Asiria, ọ da ra bọ Ninivẹh, Rehobọt-Ir, Kala, kugbe
verses.text_romanized: oto yena koye o nu kpo asiria o da ra bo niniveh rehobot ir kala kugbe

verses.text_urhobo: Resẹn vwẹ uvwre ri Ninivẹh vi Kala, kọye orere rode na.
verses.text_romanized: resen vwe uvwre ri niniveh vi kala koye orere rode na

verses.text_urhobo: Ijipt, da dia ọsẹ ri Ludim, Anamim, Lehabim, Naftu-him,
verses.text_romanized: ijipt da dia ose ri ludim anamim lehabim naftu him

verses.text_urhobo: Patrusim, Kaslu-him (kẹ Etiyin Filistia nurhe), kugbe Kaftorim.
verses.text_romanized: patrusim kaslu him ke etiyin filistia nurhe kugbe kaftorim

verses.text_urhobo: Kenan kọye ọsẹ ri Sidọn, ọmọkpako rọye, kugbe Hẹt,
verses.text_romanized: kenan koye ose ri sidon omokpako roye kugbe het

verses.text_urhobo: kugbe ihwo ri Jebus, ihwo ri Amọr, ihwo ri Gergas,
verses.text_romanized: kugbe ihwo ri jebus ihwo ri amor ihwo ri gergas

verses.text_urhobo: ihwo ri Hiv, ihwo ri Arka, ihwo ri Sin,
verses.text_romanized: ihwo ri hiv ihwo ri arka ihwo ri sin

verses.text_urhobo: ihwo ri Arvad, ihwo ri Zema kugbe ihwo ri Hamat. Ukuko rọye uvwiẹ ri Kenan na da rhe hrabọ.
verses.text_romanized: ihwo ri arvad ihwo ri zema kugbe ihwo ri hamat ukuko roye uvwie ri kenan na da rhe hrabo

verses.text_urhobo: Otọ rẹ ihwo ri Kenan da hẹre nẹ Sodọm vwẹ ẹbẹre ri Gẹra, re te Gaza, vwẹ abọ ri Sidọn, Gomora, Adma kugbe Zẹboiim, rhiri re te Lasha.
verses.text_romanized: oto re ihwo ri kenan da here ne sodom vwe ebere ri gera re te gaza vwe abo ri sidon gomora adma kugbe zeboiim rhiri re te lasha

verses.text_urhobo: Enana eye emọ ri Ham, vwẹ ekrekru rayen, vẹ ephẹrẹ rayen, otọ rayen, kugbe ẹgborho rayen.
verses.text_romanized: enana eye emo ri ham vwe ekrekru rayen ve ephere rayen oto rayen kugbe egborho rayen

verses.text_urhobo: Ji vwi Shẹm na, ọye ọsẹ rẹ emọ rẹ Ẹber ejobi, oniọvo ri Jafẹt rẹ ọkpako, ọye vwiẹ emọ kẹ.
verses.text_romanized: ji vwi shem na oye ose re emo re eber ejobi oniovo ri jafet re okpako oye vwie emo ke

verses.text_urhobo: Emọ ri Shẹm: Elam, Asshur, Apak-shad, Lud, kugbe Aram.
verses.text_romanized: emo ri shem elam asshur apak shad lud kugbe aram

verses.text_urhobo: Emọ ri Aram: Uz, Hul, Gether kugbe Mash.
verses.text_romanized: emo ri aram uz hul gether kugbe mash

verses.text_urhobo: Apak-shad kọye rha ọsẹ ri Shelah; Shelah ke rha dia ọsẹ rẹ Eber.
verses.text_romanized: apak shad koye rha ose ri shelah shelah ke rha dia ose re eber

verses.text_urhobo: Eber de vwiẹ emọ ivẹ odẹ rẹ ọvo ki Pẹlẹg, ọke rọye akpọ na vwọ hẹriẹ, odẹ rẹ oniọvo rọye ke rha Joktan.
verses.text_romanized: eber de vwie emo ive ode re ovo ki peleg oke roye akpo na vwo herie ode re oniovo roye ke rha joktan

verses.text_urhobo: Joktan kọye ọsẹ ri Almodad, Shelef, Hazarmaveth, Jerah,
verses.text_romanized: joktan koye ose ri almodad shelef hazarmaveth jerah

verses.text_urhobo: Hadoram, Uzal, Diklah,
verses.text_romanized: hadoram uzal diklah

verses.text_urhobo: Obal, Abima-el, Sheba,
verses.text_romanized: obal abima el sheba

verses.text_urhobo: Ofir Havilah, kugbe Jobab; enana ejobi na emọ ri Joktan.
verses.text_romanized: ofir havilah kugbe jobab enana ejobi na emo ri joktan

verses.text_urhobo: Otọ rẹ ayen diare hẹre ni Mesha vwẹ ẹbẹre ri Sefar re te orho rẹ ugbenu rẹ ọnre va nẹcha na.
verses.text_romanized: oto re ayen diare here ni mesha vwe ebere ri sefar re te orho re ugbenu re onre va necha na

verses.text_urhobo: Enana emọ ri Shẹm, vwẹ ekrekru rayen, vẹ ephẹrẹ rayen, otọ rayen kugbe ẹgborho rayen.
verses.text_romanized: enana emo ri shem vwe ekrekru rayen ve ephere rayen oto rayen kugbe egborho rayen

verses.text_urhobo: Enana eye ekru rẹ emọ ri Noa, kirobo rẹ orua rayen wanre, vwẹ ẹgborho rayen; vwẹ oma rẹ enana kọye ẹgborho rẹ akpọ na ejobi hra nurhe rẹ oghwe na vwọ kponu.
verses.text_romanized: enana eye ekru re emo ri noa kirobo re orua rayen wanre vwe egborho rayen vwe oma re enana koye egborho re akpo na ejobi hra nurhe re oghwe na vwo kponu
